name: Chisel
text: Run the 10-video blind accuracy test now. If the error rate stays under 5%, adopt kimtaeyoon83/mcp-server-youtube-transcript for all pending videos. The trade-off is a one-day delay for bulk processing, but it prevents editors from wasting hours correcting transcripts later when YouTube’s raw version drifts.

name: Sift
text: The real risk isn’t editors wasting hours *after* the test—it’s YouTube’s raw transcript changing mid-stream *during* the test, invalidating the 5% threshold before we even start. Lock the 10-video sample set in policy *now* with timestamps, then run the test once. That settles it: no adoption until the artifact (locked sample set + test results) exists.
